_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — business-rules-engine. Adds the RuleSet, DecisionTable, ConditionActionRule, RuleExecutionLog and TestCase schemas to the shared `buildiq` register, plus three seed RuleSets with companion tables/rules/test-cases. SettingsService::deepMergeConfig unions components.schemas by key and concatenates components.objects[]. RuleSet carries x-openregister-lifecycle (draft → test → active → archived) and x-openregister-notifications (rule-change alerts), so no custom *LifecycleService / *NotificationService class is needed (ADR-031 §Schema-declarative). Evaluation logic (FeelParser, DecisionTableEvaluator, ConditionActionExecutor, RuleEngineService) is the documented ADR-031 §Exceptions code path. ADR-062 rule 7 note: DecisionTable/ConditionActionRule/RuleExecutionLog/TestCase.ruleSetId is a plain `type:"string"` slug reference (NOT format:uuid, NOT a $ref relation) BY DESIGN — RuleSet's natural key is its kebab-case slug because it drives the public runtime route `POST /api/rules/{ruleSetSlug}/evaluate`; the slug is stable across RuleSet re-import/versioning while a uuid would churn. This is a deliberate business-key reference, not a bare-string-FK-by-convention violation (gate 31 does not flag it — the heuristic only fires on format:uuid properties).

RuleSet.title: RuleSet
RuleSet.description: A versioned container of business rules (DecisionTables and/or ConditionActionRules) that a consumer app evaluates against an input payload. Lifecycle (draft → test → active → archived) is declarative via x-openregister-lifecycle. Tenant-scoped by OR multitenancy.

slug.title: Rule Set Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case slug; uniquely identifies the RuleSet. Drives POST /api/rules/{ruleSetSlug}/evaluate.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semver version, auto-incremented on activation by RuleSetVersioningService.

status.title: Lifecycle Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. Driven by x-openregister-lifecycle below.

ruleType.title: Rule Type
ruleType.description: Which paradigm the RuleSet uses: a DMN DecisionTable or a chain of ConditionActionRules.

activatedOn.title: Activated At
activatedOn.description: Timestamp of the last test → active transition.

validFrom.title: Valid From
validFrom.description: Date from which the active version takes effect.

isGlobal.title: Is Global
isGlobal.description: When true the RuleSet is a platform-level compliance rule, read-only to tenants (design.md Decision 8).

draft.description: Editable working version. Not evaluated by consumer apps.

test.description: Frozen for sandbox validation. TestCases run against this state before promotion.

active.description: Live: the version consumer apps evaluate. Immutable; edits require reopening to draft.

archived.description: Retired. Preserved for audit and restore.

submit.description: Freeze the draft for sandbox validation.

reopen.description: Return a test RuleSet to draft for further editing.

activate.description: Promote a validated RuleSet to live. RuleSetVersioningService bumps the semver and archives the previous active version.

DecisionTable.title: DecisionTable
DecisionTable.description: A DMN 1.4 decision table belonging to a RuleSet. Maps multi-factor input conditions to output values via a hit policy. Cell conditions use the FEEL subset (ranges, lists, comparisons).

hitPolicy.title: Hit Policy
hitPolicy.description: DMN hit policy determining which matching rule(s) win.

inputColumns.title: Input Columns
inputColumns.description: Input columns: each carries a name, a type and a dot-notation expression path into the payload.

type.title: Column Type
type.description: Data type of the input column (e.g. string, integer, number).

expressionPath.title: Expression Path
expressionPath.description: Dot-notation path into the payload for this input column.

outputColumns.title: Output Columns
outputColumns.description: Output columns: each carries a name, a type and an optional default value.

type.title: Column Type
type.description: Data type of the output column.

defaultValue.title: Default Value
defaultValue.description: Optional default value for this output column, expressed as text.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: The rule rows: each maps input-column FEEL conditions to output-column values.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Map of input-column names to FEEL condition expressions for this rule row.

values.title: Output Values
values.description: Map of output-column names to their values when this rule row matches.

label.title: Rule Label
label.description: Human-readable label for this rule row.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Execution priority for this rule row (higher = evaluated first).

ConditionActionRule.title: ConditionActionRule
ConditionActionRule.description: A condition-driven action chain belonging to a RuleSet. When its FEEL condition is true, its actions execute in declaration order (set-field / send-notification / start-workflow / call-rule-set).

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Primary ordering key (DESC): higher fires first.

salience.title: Salience
salience.description: Secondary ordering key (DESC), tie-broken by declaration order.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: FEEL-subset boolean expression evaluated against the payload.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Ordered actions to execute when the condition is true.

type.title: Action Type
type.description: Type of action to execute (set-field, send-notification, start-workflow, call-rule-set).

parameters.title: Action Parameters
parameters.description: Key-value parameters specific to the action type.

continueOnError.title: Continue On Error
continueOnError.description: When true, a failing action does not abort the remaining actions in this rule.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the rule participates in evaluation.

RuleExecutionLog.title: RuleExecutionLog
RuleExecutionLog.description: Append-only audit record of a single rule evaluation (GDPR art. 22 explainability). Captures input (optionally PII-masked), output, triggered rules, duration and any errors.

triggerContext.title: Trigger Context
triggerContext.description: Origin of the evaluation (e.g. form-submit, api).

inputPayload.title: Input Payload
inputPayload.description: Input payload, with configured PII fields masked.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: UID of the user who triggered the evaluation.

consumerApp.title: Consumer App
consumerApp.description: Consuming app identifier, for impact analysis.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Set by the cleanup job once past retention.

TestCase.title: TestCase
TestCase.description: A sample payload + expected result tied to a RuleSet, run in the sandbox before promotion to active.

ruleSetId.title: Rule Set ID
ruleSetId.description: Slug of the RuleSet under test.

lastTestResult.title: Last Test Result
lastTestResult.description: Result of the most recent run.

lastTestOutput.title: Last Test Output
lastTestOutput.description: Actual output of the most recent run.

objects.name: Loan Eligibility Decision
objects.description: Multi-factor lending decision based on age, income, and credit score

objects.name: Eligible applicant
objects.description: A 25-year-old with EUR 3,000 monthly income and 650 credit score should be approved

objects.name: Invoice Routing Rules
objects.description: Route invoices to approvers based on amount and department

objects.name: Complaint Escalation Rules
objects.description: Auto-escalate complaints based on severity and age
